Results.ReviewText:
I’ve been meaning to write a review of this grill for a long time.  I bought the Spirit II E-310 in spring/summer of 2019, as a replacement for a 10-year-old Spirit model which I had absolutely loved.  The quality of my old grill was well worth the price.   I have to say that I’m extremely disappointed in the design of this new grill.  It is extremely difficult to move around.  There’s just no easy way to get a grip on it.  There are wheels on only one side of the grill (as opposed to 4 wheels on my previous model), and they are on the opposite side of a flimsy collapsible side table. The obvious method of moving the grill would be to lift it by the table (as opposed to a sturdy handle on my previous model); but the table is just too flimsy.  So I end up collapsing the table, and trying to pick it up by gripping the legs.  Very awkward.  And then today, one of the plastic wheels fell off as I was trying to move the grill. I expected much more of a grill offered at this price point.  I miss my old grill. 

Also, I've discovered that the Weber brand grill cover that I bought is not weather-proof.  This winter, we in the Northeast have had numerous snow storms that end with rain.  After each of these storms, I’ve found the grill cover frozen to the grill.  So it’s a process to get the grill cover off, and then I need to bring it inside and dry it out before putting it back on the grill.  

All in all, I do like cooking on the grill, but find other aspects of using the grill frustrating.  If I were to purchase a grill again, I’d widen my search.
Results.Title: Disappointed in Design

Results.ReviewText:
I'm happy to give my feedback on my experience so far. I've been using it for nearly 1 month.

First of all you did a very good job designing, organizing and documenting the assembly process. I must say however, the suggested build app, while well produced, added no significant assistance. I found it a waste of time early in the process and stopped using it. 

I'm mostly happy with the function of the grill.  The heat is plentiful, well controlled and even. It works well with a smoke box too. The layout is very usable and I really like the simple yet effective LP gas level indicator.  My one complaint that disappoints me each time I fire it up is the ignition. I hear it sparking, but it never ignites the gas. I always need to use another, less safe means to light the grill.  My former grill was your Q200 series and the ignition worked fine. Seems you took a step backwards in this area.
Results.Title: Feedback on my new grill
